title: Scrape
description:
Deal 7 damage.
Draw 4 cards.
Discard all cards drawn this way that do not cost 0 Energy.
upgraded_description:
Deal 10 damage.
Draw 5 cards.
Discard all cards drawn this way that do not cost 0 Energy.
notes: Scrape draws cards and discards all drawn cards that cost more than 0 energy, keeping only zero-cost cards. This includes X-cost cards in the discard. Creates a risk/reward scenario where you draw hoping to hit free cards.
